charts.title: IRAS 04125+2902 b: orbits around IRAS 04125+2902
charts.description: The orbits of IRAS 04125+2902's planets in this map from above, to scale, with IRAS 04125+2902 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Barber et al. 2024 (2024Natur.635..574B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname BARBER_ET_AL__2024): P 8.834978 d

charts.title: IRAS 04125+2902 b: its transit
charts.description: IRAS 04125+2902 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (70, 71, 86) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 56658270, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 26 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 24-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min late; 24-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 9 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
